messages:
rachael (billing): postmortem follow-up: delayed attribution in the metering pipeline produced underreported tokens across several invoices. need clear owners for the ledger backfill, credit vs reissue policy, detection rule, and customer comms.
sam (eng-infra): i can own the detection + dashboard. plan: emit metric 'attribution_delay_ms' and add rule -> #metering-alerts + create MET-7011. aiming to have a working alert and dashboard by EOD tomorrow.
mike (finance): i'll take credits and invoice correction workflow. please provide a vetted list with invoice_id, customer_id, token_delta, est_usd and a flag for 'requires_tax_review'. target: complete credits under threshold in 48h after list.
anya (customer-success): i'll draft two comms: short credit notice and a reissue advisory for larger deltas. AE-assisted outreach for strategic accounts (> $10k MRR). will need list of which accounts require AE contact.
jules (eng-sre): root cause preliminary: batching window didn't flush on transient DB lock, so tokens attributed to later windows -> appears as undercount. mitigation: add commit-timeout, idempotent commit path, and better backoff. PR in 48h, canary run in 72h.
tara (legal): note: some jurisdictions require invoice reissues instead of credit notes. include 'region' and 'tax_jurisdiction' columns in the CSV so legal can triage. i'll review reissue language.
rachael (billing): attaching preliminary extract (dirty):
```csv
invoice_id,customer_id,period_start,period_end,token_delta
inv_20260710_002,cust_acme,2026-07-10T00:00Z,2026-07-10T01:00Z,-1240
inv_20260710_015,cust_red,2026-07-10T00:15Z,2026-07-10T00:30Z,-320
inv_20260710_021,cust_orbit,2026-07-10T00:05Z,2026-07-10T00:25Z,-58
```
mike (finance): policy question: credit rounding and reissue threshold. propose: round to nearest 25 tokens for <$2k/mo, nearest 250 for >$2k/mo. use credit notes for deltas <$1,000 USD and reissue invoices for deltas >= $1,000 or tax_jurisdiction flagged.
tara (legal): that threshold looks reasonable. also require manual sign-off for customers with billing clauses (i'll provide list).
san (metering-bot): Ticket MET-7011 created: "attribution_delay_alert" assigned to eng-infra.
sam (eng-infra): detection rule sample: `attribution_delay_ms > 60000 AND estimated_token_delta <= -100` -> post to #metering-alerts and create MET-7011 with sample trace_id, shard, and proto window. will also attach a quick link to the dashboard.
jules (eng-sre): i'll add a nightly drift job that computes per-customer token delta over rolling 7d and surfaces recurring offenders (>3 incidents). ETA 6d.
mike (finance): workflow recap: 1) detection emits list -> 2) finance verifies with ledger -> 3a) if delta < $1,000 USD & no tax flags -> apply credit note within 2 business days; 3b) if delta >= $1,000 or tax flags -> prepare reissue + legal review (5 business days). will include a CSV template for AR (invoice_id,customer_id,token_delta,usd_credit,reissue_flag,requires_tax_review).
anya (customer-success): i'll prepare short and long templates and an FAQ: "how credits show up on invoice", "timeline", "who to contact". will share drafts in 18h.
rachael (billing): action items: sam -> detection + MET-7011 (EOD tomorrow); jules -> PR for commit-timeout & idempotency (PR 48h, canary 72h); mike -> credit/reissue runbook + AR CSV template (after final list, credits < $1k in 2bd); anya -> comms + FAQ (18h); tara -> legal review of reissue wording and jurisdiction flags (24h).
sam (eng-infra): i'll also add a ‘requires_approval’ boolean on the detection output for contractually constrained customers so finance knows to hold.
mike (finance): please include sample USD conversion rate and exchange rounding rules in the CSV (AR prefers two-decimal USD rounding).
tara (legal): i'll add a short clause for reissued invoices and required language for APAC.
metering-bot: MET-7011 updated: initial detections pending (2 samples queued).
rachael (billing): thanks all. i'll maintain the postmortem follow-up doc with owners & ETA and schedule a 48h check-in or earlier if MET-7011 moves to In Progress. :white_check_mark:
